text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Hmm, I wonder what I should do...

At a cafe in the city, I spotted Mejiro 
Palmer, who seemed to be fretting over 
something alongside Daitaku Helios.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hey Trainer! I was just thinking about 
grabbing some tea with Helios.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Running into you here, Trainer?! That's 
gotta mean we should all get totally hyped 
up, right?!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Right~? What should I do, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Apparently they're holding a sweets buffet 
right here right now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Look at that signboard over there. It says 
in huge letters, 'Enjoy freely, as much as 
you like,' doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
The whole "be free" thing kind of tickled 
Palmer's curiosity, you know? Right now, 
it felt like an angel and a demon were 
having a massive battle inside her, but...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa! Who's gonna win?! Isn't that 
mountain of mille-feuille crepes insane?! 
Isn't little angel-chan wild?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"No, it's already crazy bad. Feels like an 
angel is getting beaten to a pulp."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Ah, geez, I wanna eat sweets already!!
choice_data_list:
Let us fall together into the demon 
world...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Ah, geez, I wanna eat sweets already!!
choice_data_list:
Let us fall together into the demon 
world...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
W-Well, that's true...! I can't go falling 
into darkness in a place like this!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I'll pass on the buffet and just 
order something normal off the menu.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
You're seriously the best! Count me in 
too~! Alright, Trainer, I'll leave the 
buffet to you!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'll just be satisfied watching 
Trainer eat at least.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Eat a ton for our sake too, okay? Avenge 
us against that demon!

And so, while I somehow ended up having to 
eat my fill of sweets, Mejiro Palmer 
brilliantly conquered the temptation.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
S-Seriously...?! Wait, it's not like I 
plan on playing a demon for the rest of my 
life, you know?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Sounds awesome! The "Demon for a Day" 
trial course! Alright then, clerk, check 
it out☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Aah...! You already called the waiter...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Well, nothing we can do now! Let's all 
three of us go totally mega-sized today!

And so, the three of us surrendered to our 
desires, piling on the sweets and 
descending straight into the confectionery 
underworld...
